newsitem.title: USA: Fossil curtails French, British operations.
newsitem.headline: Fossil curtails French, British operations.

text.p: Fossil Inc said Tuesday it has "significantly" curtailed its operations in France and the United Kingdom because of current market conditions.
Internationally, the company said sales of Fossil branded watches by its European-based companies increased during the second quarter.
But these increases were more than offset by a decline in sales of sunglasses products and a reduction in sales derived from its operations in France and the United Kingdom.

The company said that beginning in late 1996, the number of sunglass suppliers selling into its distribution channels "significantly" increased while the retail price sunglass customers were willing to pay declined.

In reaction to these changes in the sunglasses marketplace and in an attempt to increase its market share, the company said it is increasing its sunglass assortment and introducing a "premium line" of sunglasses in the third quarter.
The company reported earnings per share for the quarter of $0.26 compared with $0.19.
